levels.surface: أبو صالح عبد الله بن صالح

notes: Second isnad («وروى مالك... عن سالم، قال بينما عمر بن الخطاب يخطب») carries the same saying; Umar is in the scene and his sermon is the saying, so whether he is the last link is unsettled (rule 6)
Two compiler-side remarks («فقال الصحيح... عن أبيه» and «وقد روي عن مالك... عن أبيه») name other chains for the same saying: variant groups
«بهذا الحديث» is read as a back reference to the saying, not to an earlier chain
«قال أبو عيسى» and «قال محمد» are commentary, not links; the compiler is not written
